description: This file defines structures and functions for pattern matching within computational graphs in the PyTorch JIT compiler, including the Match struct and the findPatternMatches function.

classes.name: Match
classes.description: A structure describing a match of a pattern in a graph, including an anchor node and maps for nodes and values.

methods.name: findPatternMatches
methods.description: Finds all matches of a pattern graph within a target graph, returning a vector of Match descriptors.
